summary: V148-R — اصلاح تازگی SQL، بازیابی IIS و امنیت و صحت استقرار

findings.cause: HasRecentSuccessfulSql ignored maxAge; verification had no timestamp; an in-flight success could overwrite invalidation.
findings.fix: Record UTC and monotonic success timestamps under the session lock; enforce caller maxAge; reject missing/expired/invalid state; clear timestamps on invalidation and reject replaced state snapshots.

findings.cause: State(profile) executed after semaphore acquisition but before its try/finally; imported null SQL fields could leak the gate.
findings.fix: Initialize state inside the protected try; always release an acquired gate.

findings.cause: Recovery flag was armed after awaiting service start, so cancellation/timeout after a partial start could skip return to normal mode.
findings.fix: Arm compensating normal restart before starting the external mutation.

findings.cause: Matching the selected root application's pool did not prove no other applications shared it.
findings.fix: Require exactly the selected root application in appcmd pool membership at preflight and immediately before STOP.

findings.cause: FinalizeSuccessfulDeployment cleared the active backup before durable Resolve; success marker was written before resolution.
findings.fix: Keep the backup reference until Resolve succeeds; GUI and CLI write success markers and GUI successful-path state after resolution.

findings.cause: Three reachable WinRM paths unconditionally bypassed CA, CN and revocation checks.
findings.fix: Use standard PSSessionOption validation in all three paths; keep existing SSL/HTTP selection and deployment safety block.

findings.cause: Readiness checked only ANCM DLL presence; bootstrap installed Hosting Bundle before enabling IIS and did not verify final prerequisites.
findings.fix: Pass configured target major to remote probe, require matching ASP.NET Core runtime plus ANCM; enable IIS first and recheck complete readiness after bootstrap.

findings.cause: Copy-Item interpreted the chosen installer as a wildcard path.
findings.fix: Use -LiteralPath and explicit -Destination while retaining apostrophe escaping.

findings.cause: CLI declared success after HTTP health and disk verification without the GUI's live API/frontend identity checks.
findings.fix: Run both existing live verification methods before COMMIT; failures enter the existing recovery path.

findings.cause: CLI used a whitespace-limited regex instead of registered secret and quoted-value redaction.
findings.fix: Route CLI diagnostics through the shared SecretRedactor.

findings.cause: Download wrote directly into a filename accepted by FindCached; cancellation left a partial installer eligible for reuse.
findings.fix: Download to a uniquely owned partial file, flush and close, publish by same-directory move only after completion; filter cache candidates by installer extension.

findings.cause: Concurrent settings/profile writes shared path.tmp, allowing one save to move another save's temporary contents.
findings.fix: Use unique temporary paths and clean up only the current write's temporary file; read-modify-write serialization remains separate work.

limitations: Remote deployment remains blocked: target-side durable exclusive lease; owned staging/backup completion and SHA256 inventory; original IIS configuration/binding/pool state restoration; cancellation/timeout recovery and live HTTP/API/frontend recovery evidence are not implemented.

SQL transport remains hardcoded Encrypt=False and TrustServerCertificate=True for local and remote SQL paths; no certificate policy/profile migration exists. Enabling validation blindly would break supported self-signed/local deployments.
Full repository line-by-line regression is PARTIAL. Unread files and gaps remain pending; fetching a file is not review.
Exclusive pool membership does not establish exclusive physical-content ownership across all IIS virtual directories, filesystem aliases or external/non-cooperating administrators.
Remote SSL now requires a trusted CA, matching target name/IP SAN and successful revocation validation; correct the certificate/trust chain rather than reintroduce bypass flags.
Atomic JSON replacement does not serialize concurrent read-modify-write settings updates; last-writer-wins remains.
Installer publication prevents new partial cache entries; it does not authenticate preexisting cached installers or establish publisher/signature provenance.
Windows/IIS/WinRM behavior, failure injection, restoration and filesystem leases remain unexecuted under USER_TESTING_POLICY.
